categories.main_business_segments: Range Intelligent Computing Technology Group primarily operates in the integrated computing power center sector, focusing on IDC (Internet Data Center) and AIDC (Artificial Intelligence Data Center) businesses. The company invests in, constructs, owns, and operates large-scale, high-performance, green computing power centers across multiple regions in China, providing server hosting, operation, maintenance, security management, and intelligent computing services to major internet companies, cloud providers, and AI model clients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including high-density and liquid cooling data center designs to meet AI computing demands and energy efficiency standards. It has developed proprietary operation and maintenance management software platforms based on international standards (ITIL, UPTIME, IFMA) and integrates AI for real-time monitoring and control of power and cooling systems. The firm also focuses on green energy solutions, liquid cooling platforms, immersive liquid cooling server racks, and intelligent security and operational management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading internet companies, large cloud service providers, and end users of large AI models. The company also serves certain national government departments. The primary markets are digital economy sectors requiring high-performance computing infrastructure, including AI, cloud computing, big data, IoT, and 5G industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: Range Technology has established computing power infrastructure clusters in six major Chinese regions: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei (Langfang), Yangtze River Delta (Pinghu), Greater Bay Area (Foshan and Huizhou), Chengdu-Chongqing economic zone, Northwest China (Lanzhou), and Hainan Free Trade Port (Danzhou). These locations form a nationwide integrated computing power center system.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the computing power supply chain, focusing on the investment, construction, ownership, and operation of data centers and intelligent computing centers. It collaborates with upstream equipment suppliers and downstream telecom operators and end customers, providing integrated hosting and computing services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes expanding its nationwide integrated computing power center system, advancing green and low-carbon data center technologies, and leading the transition to intelligent computing centers. R&D focuses on liquid cooling technologies, AI-driven operation platforms, intelligent security systems, and energy efficiency innovations to support AI and large model computing demands. The company also invests in talent development and ecosystem partnerships to enhance service capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of IDC and AIDC services, including server hosting, operation and maintenance, security management, and intelligent computing services. The company uses a wholesale model in collaboration with telecom operators, billing based on the number of server cabinets deployed and service levels provided.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Range Technology is positioned as a leading integrated computing power center provider in China, recognized for its nationwide strategic layout, high-quality green data centers, and pioneering liquid cooling solutions. It holds a competitive advantage in resource scarcity, scale, and customer trust. The company competes with other major data center operators and cloud infrastructure providers in the rapidly growing AI and digital economy sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 4.35 billion, a 60.27% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.76 billion, up 47.03%. Total assets reached RMB 23.31 billion, with net assets of RMB 8.52 billion, reflecting strong growth and a healthy asset-liability structure. The company has maintained steady growth since 2019 with a compound annual growth rate of 44.83% in revenue and 93.13% in net profit.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Range Technology emphasizes its unique value through its nationwide integrated computing power center system, early acquisition of scarce land and energy resources near first-tier cities, and its 'four self' model of self-investment, construction, ownership, and operation. The company differentiates itself with high reliability, security, green energy use, advanced liquid cooling technology, and strong customer trust built over 15 years, enabling it to meet the complex and growing demands of AI and digital economy clients.
